The structure of Lu2Co3Ni crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 225), with a 24-atom unit cell (Lu8Co12Ni4) and three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis gives each Co and Ni center 8 geometric neighbors (Co/Ni, or Co/Lu), while each Lu center has 16 neighbors (8 Co, 8 Ni). The neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Co and Ni 8-vertex polyhedra, corner sharing between Co 8-vertex and Lu 16-vertex polyhedra, and edge sharing among Lu 16-vertex polyhedra.
